property_summary: For any input, C.proxiableUUID() must return the canonical ERC-1967 IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc; the mutant returns bytes32(0), violating this for every input.
change_summary: Return a zero bytes32 value instead of the IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT so proxiableUUID() yields a different bytes32 value.
